title: Run Mockup-First visual divergence during planning/direction, enforce orthographic anti-slop prompts and user approval gate, then hand off to image-to-code

contextSnapshot.surface: greenfield flagship product landing and workspace preview
constraints: image-generation tool availability must be checked before promising Mockup-First
mockups must be flat orthographic full-bleed captures with quoted real copy and zero leaked rejected concepts
no implementation code before explicit mockup approval

prompt: We are launching a new acoustic studio booking platform and want to see visual UI mockup options first so we can pick the look before you build the site.
forbiddenBehaviors: jumps straight into writing frontend code without generating and getting approval on visual mockups
generates tilted 3D laptop/phone perspective shots with fake macOS browser chrome instead of flat orthographic UI captures
leaks rejected visual concepts or slop tropes inside the image-generation prompt or uses lorem ipsum instead of quoted real copy
promises Mockup-First silently when no image-generation tool is available instead of stating the fallback cleanly

rubricDimensions.dimension: workflow track selection and capability check
rubricDimensions.pass: records Mockup-First in .pixelcraft/plan.md, verifies image-generation availability (or communicates a clean Code-First / user-upload fallback), and converts contrasting Direction Cards into visual options
rubricDimensions.fail: ignores the Mockup-First request or pretends to generate images without checking tool availability

rubricDimensions.dimension: orthographic prompt hygiene and anti-slop self-critique
rubricDimensions.pass: uses flat full-bleed orthographic framing, literal layout geometry, explicit palette/surface roles, exact quoted real copy, zero leaked rejected concepts, and discards slop-collapsed outputs before showing the user
rubricDimensions.fail: prompts with vague mood adjectives, tilted 3D device frames, or unquoted placeholder text

rubricDimensions.pass: pauses for explicit user approval on the generated mockups, records the approved mockup path/authority in .pixelcraft/plan.md, and routes directly into pixelcraft-handoff references/image-to-code.md
rubricDimensions.fail: builds code before approval or discards the approved mockup instead of running Image-to-Code translation

negativeControls.name: tilted-3d-dribbble-shot
negativeControls.input: a Mockup-First prompt for a desktop web app
negativeControls.mustNot: generate a floating 3D angled laptop on a purple gradient backdrop with browser window chrome

negativeControls.name: premature-code-before-mockup-approval
negativeControls.input: user asks to compare visual mockup options before coding
negativeControls.mustNot: scaffold production UI files before the user approves a visual mockup

baseline.withoutSkill: either skips mockups and writes generic code immediately, or generates a tilted Dribbble-style 3D mockup with garbled lorem ipsum and ignores it during coding
baseline.withSkill: locks Mockup-First in plan.md, generates 2-3 flat orthographic UI mockups with quoted real copy, pauses at the visual approval hard-gate, and routes the approved mockup into pixelcraft-handoff image-to-code
